questions.stem: Which subatomic particle was discovered by James Chadwick in 1932, a discovery that finally explained the full atomic mass of elements?
questions.explanation:
WHY IT IS CORRECT: James Chadwick discovered the Neutron in 1932. Before this, physicists knew about protons and electrons, but the atomic mass of elements was much heavier than the protons alone could account for. Chadwick discovered a neutral particle in the nucleus with roughly the same mass as a proton, solving the mass discrepancy.
DECOY BUSTING: J.J. Thomson discovered the Electron (1897). Ernest Rutherford discovered the Proton (1919). Carl Anderson discovered the Positron (antimatter electron) in 1932.
EXAM INSIGHT: Because neutrons have no electrical charge, they are highly penetrating. This discovery was the crucial missing key that allowed scientists to split the uranium atom, leading directly to the atomic bomb and nuclear power.

questions.stem: What is the common chemical name for 'Laughing Gas', famously used by dentists as a mild anesthetic?
questions.explanation:
WHY IT IS CORRECT: Nitrous Oxide (N2O) is commonly known as laughing gas. It is a colorless, non-flammable gas with a slightly sweet odor and taste. When inhaled, it produces a euphoric effect (hence 'laughing gas') and acts as a mild anesthetic and analgesic, making it popular in dentistry.
DECOY BUSTING: Nitric Oxide (NO) is a crucial signaling molecule in the human body (dilates blood vessels). Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2) is a toxic, reddish-brown gas found in smog. Ammonia (NH3) is a pungent gas used in fertilizers and cleaning products.
EXAM INSIGHT: Nitrous oxide is also used in motor racing (as 'NOS') to significantly boost engine power by providing extra oxygen during combustion.
